conditions.text: This approval authorises operation of the harness on arena/* session branches. It does NOT authorise a merge to main: R6's land gate cannot be trusted while F3 (CI calls 'check-commits --stage land', which is not a CLI argument -> exit 2, and the step is under 'set -euo pipefail' with no continue-on-error) is open. No workflow has ever run on main (gh run list --branch main is empty), so the land gate is untested in practice, not merely mis-wired.

A1 (High, new): R4 append-only protects only the prefix as of policy/state_baseline.json base_commit 066b937, or as of a file's creation commit. state/reviews.jsonl, state/approvals.jsonl and state/review_queue.jsonl were created at or after that commit and are therefore unprotected. Proved in a throwaway clone: rewriting REV-001's 'summary' in place left 'researchos_guard.py check-all' ok=true and 'validate_researchos.py --quiet' exit 0. PRP-002 must replace the static baseline prefix with a rolling per-file hash chain (each line carries prev_line_sha256) verified back from HEAD.

A2 (High, new): an approval cites review_ids only, never the reviewed content, so the justification of an approval can be replaced after the fact without touching the approval ledger. This record therefore binds review_line_sha256 (canonical line hash of the effective REV-001) as a voluntary anchor. PRP-002 must make 'review_sha256' a required field of schemas/approval.json and have the validator compare it against the effective review line.

F1 and F2 (from REV-001) stay open and are what makes C2/C3 exploitable: check_commits compares a session's branch only for HEAD, so any non-HEAD commit may claim another session's identity (proved: a commit forging SES-c4426c6b / role bootstrap editing scripts/researchos_guard.py itself, followed by a legitimate commit, passed check-all; the same forgery at HEAD was rejected), and merge commits are skipped while --first-parent hides side-branch commits (proved: .github/workflows edited with no trailers at all, landed with --no-ff, check-all ok=true).

A3 (Medium, new): the same HEAD-only rule mis-fires on a legitimate successor session - after the handoff's own 'git merge' and before the first commit, check-all fails with '631e7bf: session SES-eb670d1f belongs to branch arena/eb670d1f-researchos'. The documented entry sequence is red until commit 1. Bind identity per commit to the session's first_commit..HEAD range (or to 'commits introduced on this branch') instead of to HEAD.

A5 (High, new): the protocol has no way to reconcile parallel session lines. Four other sessions (arena/e7ac466a, 47c55a23, e09f19e4, f63b6887) forked the same parent and wrote their own REV-001/RQ-001/PRP-002; union-merging arena/eb670d1f-researchos with arena/f63b6887-researchos produced 7 validator errors (duplicate REV-001, duplicate RQ-001 revisions, supersedes hash mismatches) while check-all still returned ok=true. PRP-002 must define a reconciliation procedure and stop minting collision-prone ids (next_id) across independent lines.

rationale: PRP-001 (governance harness) is ADOPTED ON SESSION BRANCHES, subject to C1-C6 below; this is not a claim that the harness is gap-free. schemas/approval.json allows only 'approved'|'rejected', so the conditions are carried here and in state/plan.md. Independently re-executed by SES-955f8586 (a third session: proposer SES-c4426c6b, reviewer SES-eb670d1f): validate_researchos.py exit 0; 49 unit tests OK; benchmark.py --check PASS on a fresh run (greedy 5521.41 / random 12279.86 / two_opt 4739.72 / simulated_annealing 4731.96, equal to the committed artifact); readout_snapshot matches; guard check-all ok=true; role_separation holds (this session holds approver only and researchos_verify.py refused to let it write a REV record). REV-001's verdict 'pass' was reproduced, and so were all six of its findings F1-F6. Four further findings (A1-A3, A5) were found in throwaway clones while approving; A1 and A2 are severe enough that the human merge to main must stay closed until PRP-002 lands.
scope: adopt on arena/* session branches; merge to main withheld until PRP-002 closes C2-C4, C6
